description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your jokes can get a whole battlefield laughing. A creature within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|against:performance] save against your Performance DC.

Critical Success The target is unaffected, and Infectious Joke ends for all targets.

Success The target is plagued with uncontrollable laughter. It can't use reactions for the duration of the effect. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it on each of your turns to extend the duration to the end of your next turn, up to a maximum of 1 minute. The first time each round that you Sustain the effect, choose a new creature or an already-affected creature within 30 feet to attempt the save.

Failure As success, but the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1}.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone].
